requirements.requirement: The system must include a pi_credibility object in each clinical trial response returned by evaluate_care_facade.

The system must populate pi_credibility fields exactly as defined in the PI schema (investigator_name, affiliated_institution, prior_trials_count, completed_trials_count, publications_count, fda_approval_count, prior_trial_outcomes_summary, composite_credibility_score).
The system must retrieve PI credibility data from the EVAL-CT-PI-LOGIC-001 output before constructing the API response.
The system must include a numeric composite_credibility_score for each PI in the API response.
The system must ensure the composite_credibility_score is consistently formatted as a float or integer across all responses.
The system must attach PI credibility data to the correct clinical trial record using investigator identity matching.
The system must return null or default values for all PI credibility fields when PI data is unavailable instead of omitting the object.
The system must not fail the entire clinical trial response if PI credibility logic fails for a single trial.
The system must log an error event when PI credibility data cannot be retrieved or attached to a trial.
The system must preserve backward compatibility of the evaluate_care_facade response structure for existing consumers.
The system must ensure response latency does not increase beyond acceptable thresholds due to PI credibility enrichment.
The system must serialize PI credibility data in a deterministic structure suitable for downstream LLM consumption.
The system must ensure field names and structure are semantically clear to support LLM interpretation without additional transformation.
The system must avoid including unstructured or free-text-only PI credibility data when structured fields are available.
The system must ensure prior_trial_outcomes_summary is concise and bounded in length to support LLM token efficiency.
The system must include PI credibility data for all trials in the response, not just a subset.
The system must handle cases where multiple investigators exist by selecting or aggregating a single PI credibility object per trial.
The system must return a valid API response even when EVAL-CT-PI-LOGIC-001 returns empty or partial data.
